requirements.text: Both Classic and Modern themes shall exist under the themes preferences.
Classic theme shall be displayed as in the given image.
Modern theme shall be displayed as in the given image.
"Theme Preferences" item shall be available under View menu.
"Get New Themes" item shall be available under View menu.
"Classic" item shall be available under View menu.
"Modern" item shall be available under View menu.

generated_cases.title: Verify both Classic and Modern themes exist under preferences (Normal)
generated_cases.description: Navigate to the themes preferences and verify that both Classic and Modern themes are present in the list.

generated_cases.title: Verify theme list is populated exclusively with expected themes (Edge)
generated_cases.description: Check the themes preferences to ensure the theme list contains only the expected themes without unexpected additions.

generated_cases.title: Verify exactly two themes are available under preferences (Boundary)
generated_cases.description: Count the total number of available themes under the themes preferences and verify there are exactly two.

generated_cases.title: Verify system behavior when theme files are missing (Error/Abnormal)
generated_cases.description: Simulate missing theme files in the application directory and check that the preferences handle the missing assets gracefully.

generated_cases.title: Classic theme visual verification
generated_cases.description: Verify that the Classic theme is displayed correctly as in the given reference image.

generated_cases.title: Classic theme at minimum resolution
generated_cases.description: Verify that the Classic theme is rendered correctly when displayed on the minimum supported window resolution.

generated_cases.title: Classic theme with font scaling limits
generated_cases.description: Verify that the Classic theme renders correctly at the boundary condition of system font scaling limits.

generated_cases.title: Classic theme with corrupted asset
generated_cases.description: Verify system behavior and error handling when the Classic theme asset is corrupted.

generated_cases.title: Modern Theme Display Normal
generated_cases.description: Verify that the Modern theme is displayed correctly matching the given reference image.

generated_cases.title: Modern Theme Display Edge
generated_cases.description: Verify that the Modern theme is correctly rendered when the application is displayed on maximum window resolution.

generated_cases.title: Modern Theme Display Boundary
generated_cases.description: Verify that the Modern theme renders correctly with high-contrast OS settings enabled.

generated_cases.title: Modern Theme Display Abnormal
generated_cases.description: Verify application behavior and error handling when the image asset for the Modern theme is missing.

generated_cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences item normal presence in View menu
generated_cases.description: Verify that the Theme Preferences item is present and selectable under the View menu during normal usage.

generated_cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences item via keyboard shortcut
generated_cases.description: Verify that the View menu can be opened and Theme Preferences accessed using keyboard shortcuts as an edge case.

generated_cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences menu boundary position
generated_cases.description: Verify the boundary condition where Theme Preferences is positioned as the last item in the View menu list.

generated_cases.title: Verify View menu abnormal failure to render
generated_cases.description: Verify system behavior when the View menu fails to render, ensuring proper handling of the missing Theme Preferences item.

generated_cases.title: Normal scenario for Get New Themes menu item
generated_cases.description: Verify that the Get New Themes item is present and selectable under the View menu.

generated_cases.title: Edge scenario for Get New Themes menu item
generated_cases.description: Verify the behavior when selecting Get New Themes while the system is offline.

generated_cases.title: Boundary scenario for Get New Themes menu item
generated_cases.description: Verify that Get New Themes is positioned directly below Theme Preferences in the View menu list.

generated_cases.title: Error scenario for Get New Themes menu item
generated_cases.description: Verify the system handles network timeouts gracefully when selecting Get New Themes.

generated_cases.title: Verify Classic item present in View menu (Normal)
generated_cases.description: Verify that the Classic item is present in the View menu and can be successfully identified.

generated_cases.title: Select Classic item while Modern is active (Edge)
generated_cases.description: Verify that selecting the Classic item from the View menu while the Modern theme is currently active successfully switches the theme.

generated_cases.title: Verify Classic item placement in menu (Boundary)
generated_cases.description: Verify that the Classic item is placed correctly at the top of the theme submenu or list structure.

generated_cases.title: Classic item click event unhandled (Error)
generated_cases.description: Verify the system behavior when the click event on the Classic item is unhandled or fails to execute.

generated_cases.title: Verify Modern item is present in View menu
generated_cases.description: Ensure that the "Modern" item is available as a selectable option under the View menu.

generated_cases.title: Select Modern item while Classic is active
generated_cases.description: Click the "Modern" item under the View menu while the Classic theme is currently active and verify the theme switches.

generated_cases.title: Verify Modern item placement in View menu
generated_cases.description: Check that the "Modern" item is positioned correctly adjacent to the Classic item within the menu structure.

generated_cases.title: Handle unhandled click event on Modern item
generated_cases.description: Simulate an unhandled click event on the "Modern" item under the View menu and verify the application remains stable.

reference_cases.title: TC-175
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
From the main menu bar, select Edit > Preferences > Appearance > Themes

EXPECTED RESULTS
By default, there should be at least two skins under Themes -- Classic and Modern.

reference_cases.title: TC-176
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. From the main menu bar, select Edit > Preferences > Appearances > Themes.
2. Select "Classic" theme on the right hand side of the dialog.
3. Click the "Apply Classic" button. 
4. Close the Preferences dialog. 

EXPECTED RESULTS
The following image for the menu bar of the browser should display as follows:

reference_cases.title: TC-177
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. From the main menu bar, select Edit > Preferences > Appearances > Themes.
2. Select "Modern" theme on the right hand side of the dialog.
3. Click the "Apply Modern" button.
4. Close the Preferences dialog.

EXPECTED RESULTS
The folowing image for the menu bar of the browser should display as follows:

reference_cases.title: TC-178
reference_cases.description:

1. From the main menu bar, select View.
2. Select "Apply Theme" and another submenu should pop up.
3. Select "Theme Preferences..."

EXPECTED RESULTS
The following Theme preferences dialog should appear:

reference_cases.title: TC-179
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. From the main menu bar, select View. 
2. Select "Apply Theme" and another submenu should pop up.
3. Select "Get New Themes" item

EXPECTED RESULTS
This should link to http://wp.netscape.com/themes/index.html (netscape browser).
This should link to http://mozilla.org/themes/download/

reference_cases.title: TC-180
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. From the main menu bar, select View.
2. Select "Apply Theme" and another submenu should pop up.
3. Select "Classic Theme" item.

EXPECTED RESULTS
The Classic Skin should appear to the browser menu bar.

reference_cases.title: TC-181
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. From the main menu bar, select View.
2. Select "Apply Theme" and another submenu should pop up.
3. Select "Modern Theme" item.

EXPECTED RESULTS
The Modern skin should appear to the browser menu bar.
